problem: A Go project cannot compile because two of its direct dependencies each import a different major version of the same upstream module, and Go's module system treats major versions as distinct packages, causing type incompatibilities at the boundary.
query: go modules incompatible major version transitive dependency conflict replace directive
reasoning: Using GitHub issues search to find real-world reports of Go module major version conflicts in the golang/go issue tracker and popular Go projects. Issue discussions often contain the exact resolution steps (replace directives, version pinning) that developers used.
command: ./websearch --no-cache -p github -m issues "go modules incompatible major version transitive dependency conflict replace directive"
